title: Handling of the Local Emergency Numbers List and the Extended Local Emergency Numbers List

entities.name: Local Emergency Numbers List
entities.description: Contains additional local emergency numbers used by the serving network. Can be downloaded to UE at successful registration and subsequent registration updates. Stored in UE and used for emergency number detection.

entities.name: Extended Local Emergency Numbers List
entities.description: Contains additional local emergency numbers with extended validity scope. Can be downloaded to UE and used for emergency number detection, with validity determined by EENLV field.

entities.name: Emergency number list IE
entities.description: Information element containing the Local Emergency Numbers List, sent in ATTACH ACCEPT or TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT messages.

entities.name: Extended emergency number list IE
entities.description: Information element containing the Extended Local Emergency Numbers List, sent in ATTACH ACCEPT or TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT messages.

entities.name: Extended Emergency Number List Validity field
entities.description: Field within Extended emergency number list IE that indicates whether the list is valid only in the PLMN or in the country of the PLMN.

entities.name: Emergency number detection
entities.description: Procedure where UE uses stored emergency number lists (Local, Extended, USIM, ME) to detect if dialled number is an emergency number.

entities.name: Domain selection for emergency session
entities.description: Procedure to select PS or CS domain for emergency session attempt based on dialled emergency number detection.

entities.name: CS fallback for emergency call
entities.description: Procedure where UE sends EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message for CS fallback emergency call when CS domain is selected for emergency session.

entities.name: EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message
entities.description: Message sent by UE for CS fallback indicating mobile originating CS fallback emergency call.

entities.name: EMERGENCY SETUP message
entities.description: Message sent by call control entity to network for emergency call setup in CS domain.
